bio: If you want to experience authentic Georgian cuisine, this restaurant in a commercial building just a few metres from the Vltava River is the place for you. Be sure to sample the classic khinkali, available with various fillings – they are second to none! The barbecued dishes, which are also packed with flavour, come accompanied by typical sauces. The setting is wonderfully spacious and cheerful: it features decorative elements such as traditional colourful pendant lamps and patterned fabrics. Live Georgian music adds to the atmosphere....
